mapper.sql: id, member_id as memberId, creator_name as creatorName, bio, avatar_url as avatarUrl, apply_status as applyStatus, reviewer_id as reviewerId, review_reason as reviewReason, reviewed_at as reviewedAt, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime
mapper.select: select from creator_profile where member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into creator_profile (member_id, creator_name, bio, avatar_url, apply_status, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{creatorName}, #{bio}, #{avatarUrl}, #{applyStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update creator_profile set apply_status = #{applyStatus}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_reason = #{reviewReason}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and apply_status = 0
